name: heralded-memory
question: Which experiments have demonstrated heralded entanglement between two remote quantum memories, and what herald rate, Bell-state fidelity and storage time did each report?

Q0.label: main
Q0.text: Which experiments have demonstrated heralded entanglement between two remote quantum memories, and what herald rate, Bell-state fidelity and storage time did each report?
Q0.keywords: heralded entanglement remote quantum memories experiment rate fidelity storage time

Q1.label: subject
Q1.text: Two spatially separated quantum memory nodes, such as trapped ions, neutral atoms, NV or SiV colour centres in diamond, rare-earth-doped crystals or atomic ensembles, each emitting photons entangled with a stored spin or collective excitation.
Q1.keywords: quantum memory nodes trapped ion neutral atom NV centre SiV diamond rare-earth crystal atomic ensemble spin-photon

Q2.label: approach
Q2.text: Heralded generation of entanglement between distant matter qubits by interfering emitted photons on a beam splitter and detecting them, using single-photon or two-photon Bell-state measurement or DLCZ-type schemes.
Q2.keywords: heralded entanglement photon interference Bell-state measurement single-photon two-photon DLCZ beam splitter detection

Q3.label: outcome
Q3.text: Reported entanglement heralding rate or success probability, fidelity of the heralded state to a target Bell state, and memory coherence or storage time of the entangled qubits.
Q3.keywords: heralding rate success probability Bell state fidelity coherence time storage time memory lifetime

Q4.label: context
Q4.text: Memory nodes placed in separate laboratories or buildings and connected by optical fibre, often with quantum frequency conversion to telecom wavelengths over metropolitan distances.
Q4.keywords: separate laboratories buildings optical fibre telecom frequency conversion metropolitan distance kilometres

Q5.label: comparison
Q5.text: Deterministic remote entanglement or quantum state transfer between nodes, and photonic entanglement distribution without matter memories, as alternatives to heralded memory-memory entanglement.
Q5.keywords: deterministic state transfer remote entanglement cavity photonic entanglement distribution without memory
